profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Wordpress Specialist | ReactJS | NodeJS | ExpressJS | MySQL | PHP | HTML/CSS | JavaScript
profile.summary: Determined and hardworking Full-Stack Web Developer offering more than 8 years of expertise in fast paced departments. Bilingual and well-spoken with ability to work closely with people of all different backgrounds and personalities. Passionate about building great websites and web applications. Seeking to use extensive knowledge and background in front-end and back-end web development to advance and optimize any website projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked closely on converting Figma design into a functional ReactJS app.
- Worked in a team in creating a mobile app based on Flutter software development kit.
- I contributed to the backend development team of an ExpressJS application.
positions.insights: Skills: Flutter · React.js · Express.js · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed, coded and updated Wordpress and HTML sites.
- Perform maintenance on Wordpress websites, and ensure there are no compatibility errors.
- Used programming capabilities in PHP, SQL and JavaScript and other libraries as needed.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · PSD to Wordpress · Elementor · Web Hosting · PHP · MySQL

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Created site layout and user interface using HTML and CSS practices.
- Created fully functional Wordpress themes based off of PSD files.
- Converted mockups into HTML, JavaScript, AJAX and JSON.
- Developed wireframes, site maps and content inventories for new website designs.
- Ensure all projects were fully functional prior to launching and setting the site live.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · PSD to Wordpress · WordPress · MySQL · Elementor

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Build Wordpress builds from HTML Muse renders or layered PSD designs. 
- Build fully custom websites from scratch in HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, PHP/MySQL, and JavaScript
- Maintain already built websites and ensure they are running optimal and is compatible with the latest updates of server configurations(such as PHP or MySQL version) and/or CMS or other platforms/frameworks the site uses(such as Wordpress).
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · Web Engineering · PSD to Wordpress · MySQL

positions.title: Assistant Web Developer
positions.description:
- Assisted with developing Websites in PHP/MySQL in order to work with a custom CMS.
- Assist with updating content, fixing any issues, and any maintenance a website requires.
- Design/modify graphics when needed.
positions.insights: Skills: PSD to Wordpress · WordPress · PHP
